From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmepay.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-15T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Pen test report and methodology questions

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Our security review requires a recent external penetration test report for any vendor with production access to payment flows. A few questions up front so we can move this through procurement: 

- What is your standard pentest methodology and which frameworks do you map to (OWASP, PTES, NIST, etc.)?
- Who performs the testing (firm name, brief credentials) and can you supply a statement of independence?
- What assets were in scope for your last external test and what date was the test completed?
- Do you provide a remediation tracker and do you allow a redacted copy of the full report to customers?
- Finally, what is the maximum report age you will accept for our review? Procurement is asking whether a report older than 12 months is a blocker.

I attached a short vendor questionnaire snippet that we use (see acme_vendor_questionnaire_snippet.pdf).

Could you point me at the summary and a plan to share evidence? A procurement contact is on copy.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Director, Vendor Security
Acme Payments

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmepay.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acmepay.com>
Date: 2026-02-15T10:08:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report and methodology questions

Hi Samantha,

Really appreciate the checklist — happy to help. High-level answers below; happy to jump on a quick call if you prefer.

- Methodology: Our external tests are conducted by an independent third party and include automated scanning plus manual verification and exploit validation. Findings are mapped to OWASP Top 10 (2021) and PTES where applicable. We classify findings by CVSS and business impact and provide remediation guidance.
- Vendor and credentials: The firm we engaged is PentestCo (independent vendor). They hold CREST-style accreditations and can provide CVs and a method statement on request.
- Scope and date: Last full external test covered internet-facing surfaces: API gateway, public inference endpoints, customer web console, and auth flows. Test completed on 2025-11-10.
- Deliverables: We share an executive summary, a redacted full technical report for customers, and a remediation tracker that lists severity, status, and owner. We can also provide a letter of attestation from the testing firm describing independence and scope.
- Report age acceptance: Our baseline is annual testing. For procurement — we generally accept a report up to 12 months old. In practice we allow up to 15 months where the vendor provides a signed attestation plus either a delta retest or documented remediation verification for high/critical items.

I will attach a short internal summary and ask PentestCo to send methodology/credentials directly to you. If Acme needs the unredacted report for an NDA process, let me know and we can coordinate next steps.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

- Scope: external network, public APIs, web console, authentication flows.
- Methodology: combination of authenticated gray-box assessment and unauthenticated black-box testing. We map findings to OWASP Top 10 and use PTES guidance for exploitation and reporting.
